The freighter designated '''Transport A-175''' was an [[Action IV transport]] owned by [[Red Star Shipping Lines]], and captained by [[Joh Steen]].

While traveling from the [[Nopces system/Legends|Nopces system]] to [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal]], where it was to join a convoy, the ship was ambushed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Rebel privateer|Privateer]] vessel ''[[Far Orbit]]''. As the ''Far Orbit'' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]], a ship class which had thus far only been operated by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, captain Steen believed that it was a legitimate [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] vessel, and cooperated with the requests of the privateers.
